factory_db__parts.description: Tracks individual components and raw materials.
factory_db__parts.business_context: The `parts` table is crucial for managing inventory, ensuring that the factory has the necessary raw materials to continue production. It includes details about each part such as its name, category, stock quantity, and unit price. This information helps in making informed decisions regarding procurement and restocking.

factory_db__production_lines.description: Monitors the state of the factory floor zones.
factory_db__production_lines.business_context: The `production_lines` table helps in managing the operational status of different sections of the factory. It tracks which lines are active, under maintenance, or idle, and their daily capacity. This information is essential for scheduling work orders and ensuring that production runs smoothly without disruptions.

column_descriptions.location: Physical zone in the factory (e.g., Floor 1 - Zone A)
column_descriptions.daily_capacity: Maximum units the line can process per day

factory_db__quality_logs.business_context: The `quality_logs` table maintains a detailed history of all quality checks performed on parts. It records whether each inspection passed or failed, along with the date and the inspector's name. This data is critical for maintaining product quality and identifying any issues that require corrective action.

column_descriptions.inspector_name: Name of the employee who performed the check
